cases.description: Aa changes the count: TX-01 (Mark equals 's10', Aa off) then turning Aa on gives TX-02
cases.expected: TX-01 expected, then TX-02 expected
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link. Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Doors, + Condition Mark equals s10: count 1.
Turn Aa on in that rule: count 0.

cases.description: The top connector set to OR builds GR-02 (Mark equals S10 OR Swing Angle undefined)
cases.expected: GR-02 expected
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link. Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Doors, + Condition Mark equals S10, + Condition Swing Angle undefined.
Click the connector until it reads OR: count 12.

cases.description: Build NU-04 in the panel (the picker takes Swing Angle, the count equals NU-04), save it as a custom filter, switch to a new filter, switch back: the saved filter reloads with the same count; the test deletes it
cases.expected: parameter 'Swing Angle'; NU-04 expected, and again after reload
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link. Build NU-04 (Doors, Swing Angle equals 90°): count 130.
The parameter box reads Swing Angle. Rename it (pencil), Save, then + New filter (Discard if asked).
Pick the saved filter in the source list: count 130 again. Delete it with the trash button.

cases.description: Selection sync pauses above 5,000 matches: every category in the Architectural link (SC-02) keeps the Selection sync toggle on and shows the line 'Paused: over 5,000 matches'; None clears it
cases.expected: count = SC-02 expected; Selection sync on; paused line shown; no line after None
manualSteps: Tick only the Architectural link. Filter tab: + New filter, open Categories, click All.
The count reads 11,195. The Selection sync toggle stays on, and the line under the count reads 'Paused: over 5,000 matches'. The Revit selection did not change.
Click None: the count reads 0 and the line is gone.

cases.description: T1 from the panel: the eye on the Architectural link row hides the link, the temporary bar shows one change, Reset removes the bar
cases.expected: temporary bar '1 change', then no bar after Reset
manualSteps: Explorer tab, Scope 'Whole model', Architectural link ticked: click the eye on the link's model row.
The linked building disappears in the active view and the temporary bar reads 1 change.
Click Reset: the link is back and the bar is gone.

cases.description: T3 from the panel: the eye on Doors under the Architectural link hides the linked doors through Hide in View, the temporary bar shows one change, Reset shows them again
cases.expected: eye Hidden and temporary bar '1 change', then eye Shown and no bar after Reset
manualSteps: Make {3D} the active view. Explorer tab, Scope 'Whole model', Architectural link ticked: click Collapse all, expand the link's row, click the eye on its Doors row.
The linked doors disappear in the view, the eye on Doors is off and the temporary bar reads 1 change. In Revit, Reveal Hidden Elements shows the doors as hidden in the view.
Click Reset: the doors are back, the eye is on and the bar is gone.

cases.description: Plan part A from the panel: Isolate on the first door type under the Architectural link isolates the link and hides the rest of it in the active view (T3); the temporary bar shows the changes, other link categories read Hidden, Reset shows them again
cases.expected: temporary bar with a change count, no error, type eye Shown, at least one other link category eye Hidden; then those eyes Shown and no bar after Reset
manualSteps: Make {3D} the active view. Explorer tab, Scope 'Whole model', Architectural link ticked: click Collapse all, expand the link's row, expand Doors, expand its first family.

Right-click the first type row and pick Isolate (or select the row and click its Isolate tool). Only that door type of the link stays visible in the view; the temporary bar shows a change count and no error line shows.
The link's other category rows show the closed eye. Click Reset: the linked building is back, the eyes are open and the bar is gone.

cases.description: Plan part B from the panel: Color on the first door type under the Architectural link applies a temporary rule filter (T4); the temporary bar shows, the row shows the color, Reset removes both
cases.expected: temporary bar with a change count, no error, row color #F44336; then no row color and no bar after Reset
manualSteps: Make {3D} the active view. Explorer tab, Scope 'Whole model', Architectural link ticked: click Collapse all, expand the link's row, expand Doors, expand its first family.
Right-click the first type row and pick Color… (or select the row and click its Color tool). In the picker click the first swatch (red, #F44336) and Confirm.
Those linked doors turn red in the view, the row shows a red mark and the temporary bar shows a change count. Click Reset: the doors lose the color, the mark is gone and the bar is gone.

cases.description: Categories box tree: ticking Toposolid ticks Sub-divisions, unticking its only child clears the parent, ticking it again checks the parent
cases.expected: Sub-divisions On; Toposolid Off; then Toposolid On
manualSteps: Explorer tab, Whole model, Architectural and Site links ticked. Open Categories, click None.
Tick Toposolid and open its chevron: Sub-divisions is ticked.
Untick Sub-divisions (Toposolid's only child): the Toposolid box clears. Tick it again: Toposolid reads ticked.

cases.description: Categories box search for a child lists its parent and opens it
cases.expected: rows Toposolid, Sub-divisions; chevron open
manualSteps: Explorer tab, Site link ticked. Open Categories, close the Toposolid chevron, type 'Sub-div' in the search.
The list shows Toposolid with Sub-divisions under it, the chevron open.

cases.description: Categories box selection is the tick: select Walls, add Doors, both and only they are ticked
cases.expected: ticked Walls, Doors
manualSteps: Explorer tab, Architectural link ticked. Open Categories, click None.
Click Walls, Ctrl+click Doors: only those two are ticked and neither row is painted selected.

cases.description: Explorer nests a subcategory under its parent: Site link, Toposolid 10 (2 own + 8), Sub-divisions 8 under it
cases.expected: Toposolid 10, Sub-divisions 8
manualSteps: Explorer tab, Whole model, Site link ticked. In Categories tick only Toposolid, close the box, Collapse all.
Expand the Site link row: Toposolid reads 10. Expand it: Sub-divisions reads 8.

cases.description: The Categories box eye hides Walls in the Architectural link (Temporary View Properties); Reset shows them
cases.expected: eye Hidden, temporary bar with a count; then eye Shown and no bar after Reset
manualSteps: Make {3D} active. Explorer tab, only the Architectural link ticked. Open Categories, click the eye on Walls.
The linked walls disappear, the eye is closed and the temporary bar shows a count. Click Reset: walls back, eye open, no bar.

cases.description: Filter result bar at the docked width: count, mode and sync toggle on one line, the toggle fully inside the bar and left of the overflow arrow, every tool in the bar or behind the arrow
cases.expected: one line; sync toggle inside the bar; tools in the bar or the overflow
manualSteps: Filter tab: + New filter, Categories All.
The result row stays one line; the Selection sync toggle is fully drawn; tools that do not fit sit behind the arrow at the end.

cases.description: The two selection sync toggles are separate: Explorer off leaves Filter on; Filter off hides the paused line, on brings it back; Explorer stays off
cases.expected: Filter On; paused line; gone with Filter off; back with Filter on; Explorer Off
manualSteps: Explorer tab: turn Selection sync off. Filter tab: its Selection sync is still on. + New filter, Categories All: 'Paused: over 5,000 matches'.
Turn the Filter toggle off: the line goes. On: it comes back. The Explorer toggle is still off; turn it on.

cases.description: Why hidden: Ducts hidden by the panel's eye, select a duct instance row, the strip reads 'Temporary hide/isolate' with Show; the close button closes it
cases.expected: 'Temporary hide/isolate' with Show; closed by the close button
manualSteps: Explorer tab, Current model ticked, Categories only Ducts. Collapse all, expand Current model, click the eye on Ducts.
Expand Ducts down to an instance and select it: the strip reads 'Temporary hide/isolate' with Show. Click the close button, then Reset.

cases.description: Keep asks first when linked elements are hidden: Doors hidden under the Architectural link, Keep shows the question, Cancel keeps the bar, Reset clears it
cases.expected: question '… link elements stay hidden in this view'; Cancel keeps the bar; Reset clears it
manualSteps: Make {3D} active. Explorer tab, Architectural link ticked: Collapse all, expand the link, click the eye on Doors.
Click Keep: the bar asks 'N link elements stay hidden in this view' (Keep · Cancel). Click Cancel: the bar stays. Click Reset.

cases.description: Row context menu (B56): Shift+F10 on Doors under the Architectural link lists Zoom, Isolate, Hide, Halftone, Color and Why hidden (Select only while selection sync is off); Hide hides the linked doors; Reset shows them
cases.expected: menu lists Zoom, Isolate, Hide, Halftone, Color, Why hidden (Select only while selection sync is off); eye Hidden, bar with a count; then no bar
manualSteps: Explorer tab, Whole model, only the Architectural link ticked: Collapse all, expand the link, select the Doors row.

Press Shift+F10 (or right-click): the menu lists Zoom, Isolate, Hide, Halftone, Color and Why hidden? (Select shows only while selection sync is off). Click Hide: the Doors eye reads Hidden and the bar shows a count.
Click Reset: the bar goes away.

cases.description: Categories box menu (B31): Shift+F10 on the ticked Walls row, Isolate, Reset, then Halftone, Reset
cases.expected: Isolate: bar with a count, then no bar; Halftone: bar with a count, then no bar
manualSteps: Explorer tab, Whole model, only the Architectural link ticked: open Categories, click None, tick Walls.
Press Shift+F10 on the Walls row (or right-click it), click Isolate: only walls stay drawn and the bar shows a count. Click Reset.
Open the menu again, click Halftone: walls draw halftone and the bar shows a count. Click Reset.

cases.description: Result row menu (B91): build TX-01, Shift+F10 on the result row, Hide hides the matching door, Reset shows it
cases.expected: TX-01 count; bar with a count; then no bar
manualSteps: Filter tab, Whole model, only the Architectural link ticked: + (new filter), Categories Doors, rule Mark equals 's10' (1 match).
Click the mode box in the result row and press Shift+F10 (or right-click the row), click Hide: the bar shows a count.
Click Reset: the bar goes away.

cases.description: Saved-hide dot (LH-03): in Active view, Doors under the Architectural link hidden with the eye and kept stay hidden, saved with the view, and the row shows the orange dot; the eye shows them again and the dot goes away
cases.expected: no dot before; dot and eye Hidden after Keep; no dot and eye Shown after Show
manualSteps: Make L3 active. Explorer tab, Active view, only the Architectural link ticked: Collapse all, expand the link.
Click the eye on Doors, then Keep and confirm Keep: the bar goes away, the Doors eye reads hidden and a small orange dot shows left of the row tools.
Click the Doors eye again: the doors show and the dot goes away.
